name: CineStream
description: One stop solution for Movies, Series, Anime, AsianDrama and Torrents (includes CineAnime: AniList + TMDB + AnimePahe). v549: invisible-mode hardening + Android TV support. (1) Headless solver loads the challenge page exactly once (no cancelled second load that broke API-endpoint solves). (2) cf_clearance token now requires 15+ chars and a non-challenge title before saving — no placeholder tokens accepted. (3) All WebView teardown goes through one runCatching path — no crash if the Activity dies mid-solve (common on TV). (4) One invisible solve at a time: parallel challenged requests join the in-flight solve instead of spawning duplicate WebViews. (5) On Android TV, if invisible solve fails (interactive Turnstile checkbox a headless WebView can't tap), falls back to visible D-pad-navigable dialog. (6) D-pad cursor clamped to WebView bounds on TV. (7) Check cookies now uses checkCookieValidity (VALID/INVALID/NO_COOKIE/UNKNOWN) instead of fail-open boolean. (8) All v548 fixes retained: per-host cookie read/save (no cross-mirror merge), per-domain settings rows, client hints sec-ch-ua-mobile/sec-ch-ua-platform, empty-UA guard, host-aware app-open and per-request solving.
